info.0: Neapolitan pizza is the version of the round pizza typically prepared in the Italian city of Naples.
info.1: and characterised by a soft, thin dough with high edges.
info.2: The tomatoes are traditionally either San Marzano tomatoes or pomodorini del Piennolo del Vesuvio.

1.name: Margherita
1.description: A timeless classic, the Margherita pizza offers a simple yet rich combination of fresh tomato sauce, creamy mozzarella, and fragrant basil leaves.

2.name: Pepperoni
2.description: A great classic with a bold taste, this pizza is topped with layers of spicy pepperoni, melted mozzarella, and a flavorful tomato base.

3.name: BBQ Chicken
3.description: A flavorful twist on tradition: BBQ chicken, smoky BBQ sauce, caramelized onions, and melted mozzarella.

4.name: Hawaiian
4.description: A sweet and savory mix with pineapple, ham, mozzarella, and tomato sauce.

5.name: Veggie
5.description: Fresh and colorful pizza loaded with vegetables and mozzarella on a tomato base.
